title: geranium bohemicum subsp. lanuginosum
intro: Geranium bohemicum subsp. lanuginosum, commonly known as the woolly geranium, is a subspecies of the Geranium bohemicum plant, a type of flowering plant in the geranium family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The woolly geranium has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, providing potential health benefits in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as supporting immune function and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the woolly geranium include geraniin, geranin, and other flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
